spec.notes: 64 x 64 tokens (8 x 8 windows of 8) x4, align_corners=True: the head: C1's 64 x 64 logits onto the 256 x 256 output (UpsamplingBilinear2d). The 256 x 256 output is read as its 4 diagonal 64 x 64 blocks (the window lane's side limit at window 8 is 64): together they hold every child-window row and column, so every local matrix of both axes. Exact: the float32 weights are PyTorch's; every y-stage product is exact in double and each output adds two of them, one rounding in any order. The x stage's rounded products and rounded sum (the mirror; Milestone 11 found Earth Engine does not fuse) and both fused multiply-adds round to the same float32 at every output on this data (tests/test_c0b_window8.py), so the flag holds in any order, fused or not.
